historical_reviews.deepseek: Its literal item-name lookup is not the source's nvme scope and its truncated fallback cannot prove complete sensor coverage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly gates execution on the actual drive-to-sensor mapping, normative SPEC and complete four-view comparison.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A grep match for `nvme` is discovery evidence, not proof that every populated M.2 slot has the correct SDR entity and live sensor. The comparison must start from approved physical topology and cover expected absent slots without mistaking an empty grep result for either pass or fail.

original_test_intent: Validate every applicable M.2/NVMe sensor's identity, description and live reading in both SDR and Sensor views through verified in-band and out-of-band paths against the approved platform specification.
original_method: Map installed M.2 devices and expected slots to canonical sensor IDs; collect complete protected SDR and Sensor outputs through same-target IB/OOB paths; normalize entity/name/description/reading/unit/status/threshold/freshness; perform a topology-aware four-way SPEC comparison while preserving logs and system state.
manual_activity: The owner/vendor supplies the installed-slot topology, canonical sensor mapping, SPEC ranges and absent-state rules; the operator resolves ambiguous or missing resources and sets the final verdict.
safety_requirements: Never change thresholds, events, fans or storage state
Do not clear SEL or OS logs
Do not use a literal item label as a sensor ID
Do not truncate output before completeness checks
Fail closed on topology or path mismatch
Never retry automatically to hide stale or divergent data
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete SDR and Sensor views on both paths
Compare four views against SPEC and absent-state rules
Archive no-mutation evidence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Supply normative SPEC and range/status rules
Review missing, duplicate, stale or divergent sensors

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It queries a guessed non-source sensor name, truncates the SDR list, omits OOB evidence and uses an insecure SSH wrapper; it cannot satisfy the two-view/two-path criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected complete `sdr elist` and `sensor list` collection through verified IB/OOB paths, then filter only after parsing against the approved M.2 slot and canonical sensor map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The SDR/Sensor dual-view and IB/OOB scope with 10/10 minutes is preserved; malformed transport, guessed names and premature truncation are removed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-slot matrix of installed device identity, expected sensor/entity, SDR fields, Sensor fields and IB/OOB results, including explicit absent and unavailable states with timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Uses physical topology and canonical IDs before text filtering, validates complete outputs and preserves diagnostic evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single `nvme` grep can miss naming variants, duplicate matches, unpopulated slots, stale readings and discrepancies between SDR metadata and the live sensor view.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sensor exposure may differ by firmware or device population; without a versioned SPEC and topology, automation cannot decide whether absence is expected.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define whether M.2 includes all NVMe form factors present or only named M.2 slots, and map each expected slot to its BMC SDR entity. E1.S row 1662 remains separate and must not substitute for this scope.
expected_evidence: Target identity, firmware, slot/device topology and SPEC version
Complete redacted SDR and Sensor output from IB/OOB
Four-way SPEC comparison with absent/duplicate analysis

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, commands and criteria consistently address M.2/NVMe sensors. The malformed OOB syntax and absent mapping/SPEC are execution defects and prerequisites, not competing objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, sensor mapping and SPEC are obtainable project inputs. Execution reports BLOCKED if they remain unavailable or complete same-target views cannot be collected.

review_improvement: Prevents a guessed name and partial grep output from passing a platform sensor-coverage requirement by anchoring every comparison to physical topology and canonical records.
independent_technical_reasoning: SDR metadata can exist for an unpopulated slot while `sensor list` reports unavailable, and multiple devices may share `nvme` text without unique slot identity. Conversely, a valid M.2 sensor may omit that substring. A topology-first join across entity/record IDs and both transport paths is therefore necessary before applying value and status criteria.
